name: create_ts_partial_update
description: Writes a typed immutable merge using Partial<T>
prompts: Create update.ts exporting a generic function applyUpdates<T extends object>(obj: T, updates: Partial<T>): T that returns a NEW object with the updates merged over obj - the original object must not be mutated. Updating a field with a value of the wrong type must be a compile error under `tsc --strict`. Fields explicitly set to undefined in updates should not overwrite existing values (skip undefined values when merging).

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit update.ts type_tests.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build update.ts
node behavior_test.js
